text:
maria: Quick sync — we need the final benchmark narrative for the launch post and the webinar. Primary story: latency vs $/token tradeoffs + routing options (hosted / dedicated / private). Draft chart ideas: slice-by-SLA waterfall, tokens->$ heatmap, and a compact cost-per-1k table. PLG hook + enterprise CTA. Thoughts?
aj: Love those charts. Priorities: 1) One simple chart non-technical folks instantly get — p95 latency vs cost per 1k tokens with 3 highlighted use cases (chat, summarization, embeddings). 2) Heatmap for devs/infra folks showing batch size x seq len -> $/token. Use dotted lines to show dedicated vs hosted pricing. Keep axis labels explicit. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
liam: Webinar angle — call it "Serving Economics: predictable latency, predictable spend". Slides should end with 2 CTAs: self-serve link + enterprise consult (tracked). For inbound routing, add a tiny checkbox flow on the landing that asks scale + security needs, then route lead to AE or self-serve.
sophie: Data provenance notes: we must call out region (us-west-2), model versions, prompt templates, and sample sizes (n requests per slice). Also add a footnote about quantization assumptions. If we use synthetic workloads we should label as such.
jordan: Short headline options for social copy: 1) "Latency you can budget for." 2) "From model ownership to serving economics." 3) "Cut cost per token without the latency tradeoff." Pick 1 or 2. :sparkles: 
maria: @aj @liam @sophie assigning owners: aj for headline + copy, liam for webinar logistics + slide assembly, sophie for data validation + notes, jordan for social hooks. I’ll draft the launch post skeleton by EOD.
liam: I can assemble slides — send data slices and a code snippet for chart generation. Example chart snippet we can run on the perf CSVs: ```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
df = pd.read_csv('latency_cost_slices.csv')
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='cost_per_1k', y='p95_ms', hue='deployment')
```
maria: deploy-bot posted: https://docs.internal/redwood/benchmarks/launch-data (sheet with slices + raw traces) — please use that as single source of truth.
aj: For the launch post, recommend 2 visuals only on the page (hero chart + small table). Save the heatmap for the webinar and technical appendix. Short bullets: what we measured, why it matters (PLG + infra), clear next steps for AEs.
sophie: Quick ask — can we flag anything sensitive in the sheet (customer traces)? I’ll scrub and add a data provenance row.
jordan: Also add one slide that visually shows routing fallback: hosted -> dedicated -> private with latency/cost arrows. Helps enterprise buyers understand gradations.
maria: Great — timeline: draft post + hero chart by EOD tomorrow, webinar deck draft by Wed, landing + routing rules for lead flow by Thu. AEs and growth please review Fri. Thanks all. :rocket:
